family_definition: Original six contrasts plus six expanded-window contrasts; original registered family-6 results retained as reference, no best-window selection
power_scope: Fixed-effect sensitivity from historical paired-path variability, never observed-effect post-hoc power. Conditional stationarity and normal approximations; neither prospective guarantee nor a training-process bootstrap.
rationale: Earliest dates satisfying unchanged 60-row inner fits, 24 matured validation origins and 12 observations per state; allocation retains a complete 60-month covariance window and at least 60 known label/return pairs. Data-only gate, no performance-based start selection.
